description_en: Queries whether the blocking feature has data anomalies or disabled associated policies
description_zh: 查询封禁功能关联策略是否存在数据异常或被关闭的情况
name: DescribeBlockingStatus

Data.description_en: The business result returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

ClosedAclUuids.description_en: The list of UUIDs of ACL policies that have been disabled and whose identifiers can be retrieved
ClosedAclUuids.description_zh: 已被关闭且可获取标识的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表

items.description_en: The UUID of a disabled ACL policy
items.description_zh: 一条已关闭的 ACL 策略 UUID

ClosedAclUuids.title_en: 被用户关闭的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表
ClosedAclUuids.title_zh: 被用户关闭的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表

CorruptAclUuids.description_en: The list of UUIDs of ACL policies that have data anomalies and whose identifiers can be retrieved
CorruptAclUuids.description_zh: 存在数据异常且可获取标识的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表

items.description_en: The UUID of an ACL policy with data anomalies
items.description_zh: 一条数据异常的 ACL 策略 UUID

CorruptAclUuids.title_en: 数据异常的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表
CorruptAclUuids.title_zh: 数据异常的 ACL 策略 UUID 列表

HasAclClosed.description_en: Indicates whether associated ACL policies have been disabled by the user
HasAclClosed.description_zh: 是否存在被用户关闭的关联 ACL 策略
HasAclClosed.title_en: 是否存在 ACL 策略被用户关闭
HasAclClosed.title_zh: 是否存在 ACL 策略被用户关闭

HasDataCorrupt.description_en: Indicates whether anomalous associated policies or address book configurations exist
HasDataCorrupt.description_zh: 是否存在异常的关联策略或地址簿配置

InGrayRange.description_en: The compatibility and availability identifier of the blocking feature. The current value is true. This does not indicate that specific blocking policies have taken effect
InGrayRange.description_zh: 封禁功能的兼容可用性标识，当前返回 true；不表示具体封禁策略已生效
InGrayRange.title_en: 当前用户是否在封禁功能灰度范围内
InGrayRange.title_zh: 当前用户是否在封禁功能灰度范围内

IsHealthy.description_en: Indicates whether no data anomalies or disabled configurations are found in the blocking feature associated configurations. A value of true does not indicate that specific blocking tasks have been completed successfully
IsHealthy.description_zh: 封禁功能关联配置是否未发现数据异常或被关闭。true 不代表具体封禁任务已成功完成
IsHealthy.title_en: 封禁模块是否健康（无异常）
IsHealthy.title_zh: 封禁模块是否健康（无异常）

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. An empty string is returned when the request succeeds. The example value InvalidParam indicates that the request parameter is invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

Message.description_en: The description of the request result. The value is success if the request was successful, or an error description if the request failed
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. A value of false indicates a failure. For asynchronous operations, a successful response does not indicate that the task has been completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
